blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — PMI Bohol Boxing Stable’s Richard “The Badz” Laspona gets another shot at a regional title as he takes on India’s Pradish Anbuchezhian for the vacant International Boxing Federation (IBF) Asia flyweight championship in the main event of “Kumong Bol-Anon 27” on December 19 in Tagbilaran City, Bohol.
